limitations: Headless packet tests do not render or automate the Bedrock inventory UI.
Retail inventory drag behavior and attachable rendering require a retail client test.

reportedBeforeThisChange: Stone shown small and far away at the upper left of first-person view.
Ender pearl mostly below the bottom center of the view.
Torches retain a good vanilla appearance.
Food display and eating animation previously confirmed improved.
changes: Tag owned non-food fallbacks, excluding all torch variants, to select a mirrored vanilla first-person right-arm pose on the left arm.
Extend only animation.player.first_person.empty_hand; preserve its original right-arm and item-pivot formulas.
Enable Geyser integrated resource pack on the isolated server.
renderVerification.preservedAssets: All existing food geometry, animations, controllers, attachables and icon aliases are byte-identical to version 6 (food content previously tested in version 5).
renderVerification.scope: No player entity/root controller override; pose animation runs only in the existing first-person controller; no change to third-person pose.
